A 108° Straight Peak sits at the outer edge of traditional tailoring. The combination of a wide opening angle, straight gorge, and long projection produces the strong "spear-point" effect visible in the illustration. It is especially effective on double-breasted jackets and statement formalwear where maximum chest emphasis is desired.
